meta.title: Git branch graph
meta.description: Reserves a right-side layout track for a read-only Git branch graph during development tasks, so the conversation moves left; the native right-sidebar handle resizes the graph. Tracks multiple recently modified local and SSH-remote projects in one conversation, normalizes them to their Git repository roots, and offers project switching. It replaces the no-repository error with a safe creation wizard. The wizard browses and previews project subdirectories, enforces file-count and size limits, excludes secrets and dependencies through .git/info/exclude, creates the first commit for empty repositories, and can create and push a GitHub, Gitee, self-hosted, or existing repository. For GitHub/Gitee it discovers local Git credential helpers, ~/.git-credentials, GitHub CLI credentials, and environment tokens, with account selection for multiple credentials. Tokens stay in Host memory, are never sent to the browser, saved, or written to .git/config. Requires a live Session and local Git. Disable the bundle to remove the panel, repository actions, and authenticated routes.
